description.value: The Penticton Community Centre is a City of Penticton–operated public facility offering a pool and fitness room to residents and visitors in the South Okanagan. As a full-service municipal rec centre, it has the potential to serve touring cyclists needing showers or a place to freshen up mid-route. Penticton sits at the heart of several major cycling corridors including the Kettle Valley Rail Trail.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched is almost entirely repeated navigation menus across multiple subpages, with very little body content specific to the Penticton Community Centre page itself. The nav structure confirms the facility has a Pool and Fitness Room, and the city site has a 'Bike Parking & Amenities' section, but that appears to be a citywide page rather than evidence of bike parking at this specific facility. No address, phone, or specific amenity details are present in either the OSM record or the retrieved website content.
concerns: Website content block returned only repeated navigation menus with no substantive body text about the Community Centre's specific amenities or facilities.
No address or phone number present in OSM tags; these fields could not be confirmed.
OSM category 'Attractions' may be a mismatch — this is a municipal recreation centre, not a tourist attraction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The facility is a legitimate public municipal rec centre that could serve touring cyclists (pool showers, washrooms, water), but the fetched website content is almost entirely navigation menus with no body text confirming any specific cyclist-relevant amenities. A manual review of the actual facility page or a site visit is needed to confirm required criteria before listing.
